capabilities: Lock scroll of two adjacent Markdown panes by pixel distance
Preserve independent starting positions when locking
Hold Alt to scroll a single pane without breaking the lock
Toggle the lock from the status bar, ribbon, note header, or command palette
extras: Desktop only (Windows-tested; macOS and Linux untested); exactly two horizontally adjacent Markdown panes, no mobile, PDF, Canvas, or pop-out windows. Locking removes any native tab link between the panes and it is not restored on unlock. Pixel-based sync does not align matching text, so passages can drift.
intentEvidence: Unlike native linked tabs, this plugin preserves an arbitrary starting offset.
problem: Obsidian's native linked tabs jump panes to matched locations, so you cannot compare two passages that start at different points in the same or different notes.
summary: Scroll lock for two side-by-side Markdown panes that preserves arbitrary starting offsets and synchronizes movement in pixels.
